name: sc5i
goal: Scenario 5 I: label read; harness locates the cap (grid) -> WALLX prompt 1 with its cell (25 calls); a person moves the cap; harness lifts the arm, backs to rest, RE-SCANS the table -> WALLX prompt 2 with the NEW cell, same target zone (65 calls); release, home. All cameras.
setup: Cap in the centre of the table, label to the camera; trays in zones 1 and 2; arms at rest. Move the cap while WALLX reaches for it in the first ~40 s.
